items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: One of the greatest reading trumpet and jazz trumpets. He was Andrew Kimball, Joe Oliver, and Mario Perez. That was the stiffest trumpet players they had around here.

ctx.x: Sure, people worked with many of them. I hope to tell you. And all my twi in there, many of them. And one of our great trumpet players we had around here, the people in the city, didn't talk too much about it, but he was always working. You couldn't even tell you it was Andrew Kimball. One of the greatest reading trumpet and jazz trumpets. He was Andrew Kimball, Joe Oliver, and Mario Perez. That was the stiffest trumpet players they had around here. It says, buddy of bowling, stop. I mean stiff in musicals and…
Did you ever hear buddy of bowling? That's my boy satisfied.
